shortLetter: 365 days of loving you, holding your hand, fighting over silly things, laughing until we forget everything else, and building a little world of our own. From a Bumble match to the woman I want to call my wife, you have become my favourite part of life. Happy 1st Anniversary, my Potato Babu. ❤️ One more year, and hopefully, I'll get to call you my wife. Until then, and long after that, it's always going to be you and me.
longLetter:
My sweetest Babu

	One whole year. Can you believe it? It feels like just yesterday we matched on Bumble and started talking, not knowing that a simple conversation would eventually turn into us. From hearing your voice for the first time to our first video call, from that magical first meeting on January 11th to our first kiss, every little step brought me closer to you. And now, here we are, celebrating one whole year together.

	When I look back at everything we've shared, I can't help but smile. Our first Saraswati Puja, you looking like an angel in that pink saree; our first Book Fair, the octopus fry, and you buying a storybook for my father even before meeting my parents; our Valentine's week adventures, our first Valentine's Day, and all those little moments that became precious memories. I'll always remember how you woke up at 4 AM to meet my parents, how beautiful you looked in your birthday dress, and our Astomi together with matching outfits, your gorgeous saree, endless laughter, and 263 photos in a single day. Even the little things, like showing you around my Santiniketan, mean so much to me because I get to experience them with you.

	Of course, our relationship hasn't been perfect. We've had fights, misunderstandings, doubts, and days when life felt unfair. We've both changed in some ways, and we've had to learn how to love each other through real-life problems, not just the happy, easy moments. But you know what makes me happiest? We keep finding our way back to each other. Even when we fight, we try to understand each other, talk things through, and make things better. We may never stop fighting over silly things after all, that's one of our specialities. but I hope we never stop trying to understand each other, either.

	Batu, I know life hasn't always been kind to you. I know I can't magically solve every problem for you, and sometimes all I can do is listen, stand beside you, and remind you that you don't have to face everything alone. But I want you to know that I never looked at your struggles and thought I should find someone else. I don't want a different girl or some imaginary, easier life. I want you. The same girl I fell for when we first met, the girl who became so special to me, and the girl I want beside me when life gets difficult, too.

 We'll have responsibilities, stressful days, and problems we won't always know how to solve immediately. But I want us to face those things as a team. We're building a future together, and I want us to keep learning, improving, and making decisions that bring us closer to the life we dream about.

	And, my Batu, please don't ever feel that you have to compete with someone else for my love. I don't want you worrying that I'll suddenly find someone better or leave you for another person. I'm choosing you because you're you with your sweetness, your stubbornness, your little moods, your beautiful heart, and all the things that make you my Babu. I can't promise that every day will be perfect, but I can promise that I want to keep choosing this relationship and working on it with you. I want to earn your trust through my actions, not just words, and I want you to feel secure in the love we share.

	And honestly, even after all this time, you're still my cute little Batu. No matter how much we grow, how many times we fight, or how many new memories we make, I hope we never lose these silly little things that belong only to us.

	Now, when I think about the future, I get genuinely excited. Next year, if everything goes as we hope, we'll take that big step and get married. Just imagining you as my wife makes me happy. I want to build a home with you, share ordinary mornings and exhausting evenings, celebrate our achievements, support each other through difficult days, and keep making memories long after this first anniversary becomes a distant memory. I know marriage won't mean that life suddenly becomes easy, but I hope it means we'll face even more of it together.

	Thank you for coming into my life, for all the effort you've put into us, for the memories we've made, and for continuing to choose me even when things aren't easy. Thank you for being my Batu, my Potato, my favourite person to annoy, and the woman I hope to call my wife next year.

	Happy 1st Anniversary, my love. One year down, and hopefully a lifetime to go. Whatever life brings us, I want us to keep talking, keep understanding each other, keep laughing at our stupid jokes, and keep choosing one another not just on anniversaries, but on all the ordinary days in between.

	I love you, Batu. Today, tomorrow, and for all the days we're lucky enough to share. 

Forever yours,
Your Dudull

timeline.title: Where Our Story Began
timeline.description: It all started with a match on Bumble and a simple conversation over text. Little did we know that a few messages would be the beginning of something so beautiful ❤️

timeline.title: The First Time I Heard Your Voice
timeline.description: You weren't quite fond of me yet, but something in my heart told me there was a beautiful soul behind that voice

timeline.title: The First Time I Saw Your Smile
timeline.description: Our first video call felt magical; you were so beautiful and cute, and you still are, inside and out.

timeline.title: The Day Doubts Turned Into Love
timeline.description: You came with a thousand doubts, but one meeting was all it took for you to fall for me and that first kiss felt like pure magic. 💋

timeline.title: Choosing You, Without a Doubt
timeline.description: The day I told my father about us, I made one thing clear: I couldn't imagine marrying anyone but you, and they agreed. ❤️ And when they finally met you, your beauty, warmth, and beautiful heart made it easy to understand why you were the one I chose.

timeline.title: My Angel in a Pink Saree
timeline.description: Our first Saraswati Puja together, and you looked like an angel who had lost her wings. ❤️ In that pink saree, you were so breathtakingly beautiful that I couldn't keep my eyes or my hands away from you. 💗

timeline.title: Little Gestures, Endless Love
timeline.description: Our first Book Fair together, filled with new experiences, including the octopus fry you treated me to for the first time! 🥹❤️ What touched me most was how you bought a storybook for my father even before meeting my parents you were already finding little ways to become part of my world.

timeline.title: Our Little Valentine Week Adventure
timeline.description: From February 8th, 12 days of endless adventures, our first bike rides, Eco Park, flower markets, bookstores, and countless little memories. ❤️ I wanted to make our first Valentine's week special, giving you not just gifts, but moments we'd cherish forever.

timeline.title: Every Mile Was Worth It
timeline.description: My first Valentine's Day with you, a two-hour ride to Ashoknagar that felt worth every second. ❤️ Seeing you in that red-and-black outfit, wearing your beautiful smile, made it a day my heart will always hold close.

timeline.title: The Day You Met My Parents
timeline.description: You woke up at 4 AM and made the tiring journey to meet my parents, and thankfully, everything went beautifully because of you. ❤️ The effort you put in, time and time again, means more to me than words can ever express.

timeline.title: Miles Apart, Never Far at Heart
timeline.description: We were heartbroken to say goodbye at the airport, knowing distance would always be a part of our story. ❤️ But we promised each other that distance would only ever be measured in miles, never in the closeness of our hearts.

timeline.title: Your Birthday, My Favourite Celebration
timeline.description: Celebrating your birthday together, with you looking absolutely adorable in that pink dress, was so special to me. 💗 I hope it was your best birthday ever, because making you smile and feel loved will always be one of my favourite things.

timeline.title: Our Most Magical Astomi Together
timeline.description: Matching ethnic outfits, your beautiful saree, endless laughter, and 263 photos in a single day our Astomi was pure magic. ❤️ I'm sorry you walked so much despite your period and foot pain, but that day of boundless love and happiness will forever be one of my most treasured memories.

timeline.title: You in My Favourite Saree
timeline.description: You looked irresistibly beautiful in the black-and-white satin saree I chose for you, and I finally got to show you a little piece of my Santiniketan. ❤️ Next year, I promise you'll play Sindoor Khela too you would've looked absolutely breathtaking!

timeline.title: One Year of Us, A Lifetime to Go
timeline.description: One year of beautiful memories, endless love, and a trust we've built together. ❤️ We've had our share of fights and difficult moments, but we've always found our way back to each other, proving that what we have is stronger than any challenge.

Saraswati Puja vibes with my hottie angel in a pink saree. 😍
Two absolute madlads in front of Central Mall. No posing skills, just us being our NORMAL selves.

Right after buying your favourite flowers. 🌻

Our very first Valentine's Day together! That two-hour journey was worth every second because it ended with you, my favourite Valentine. 💝
A day at your favourite indoor sports place! More fun, more laughter, and another excuse to spend the whole day with you.

Just one more kiss to remember. If I had my way, Batu, I would never have to stop kissing you.

Your actual birthday, celebrated with your favourite person, which is me, obviously. I will celebrate every birthday with you for the rest of our lives.
Damn, Batu. Those thighs...Sometimes I genuinely wonder how I got so lucky to have a wife this gorgeous. Respectfully… I am NOT normal about you.
After all those waits, little fights, and failed attempts, we finally got ONE good photo together. Worth the struggle, though. Look at us, love
FINALLY, after soooo many days apart, I got to see you again! No matter how long the wait, seeing your face makes everything feel worth it.
Naughty Batu caught in the act.
Nothing but a real movie shot. Somebody call the director—we've got the lead couple ready!
And ANOTHER movie shot! At this point, our relationship needs its own Bengali romantic film. I'd watch it a thousand times, especially for the heroine.
Your first time visit in Sonajhuri! Getting to show you these beautiful places and experience the festivities together made it even more special.
Batu, you looked SO good that day. I wanted to pull you close and kiss you right there. How am I supposed to behave normally when my Batu looks like THAT seductive?
And of course, we couldn't end our memories without our FULL FAMILY PHOTO! From two strangers on Bumble to this beautiful little world.

promises: I promise to keep choosing you, not just on the beautiful days when everything feels easy, but also on the difficult days when life tests our patience and love.
I promise to be someone you can lean on when life feels overwhelming. I may not always have the answers or be able to fix every problem, but I'll listen, stand beside you, and face things with you.
I promise to believe in your dreams, encourage you when you doubt yourself, celebrate every little victory, and remind you of how capable you are when things don't go as planned.

I promise to communicate honestly, listen even when we disagree, and try to understand your feelings instead of focusing only on proving myself right. Even when we fight, I'll always want us to find our way back to each other.

I promise to keep building a future with you through sensible decisions, mutual support, and teamwork. We'll learn to handle our responsibilities together and work towards the life we dream of sharing.

I promise to make you laugh on your heaviest days, annoy you with my stupid jokes, tease you about being my little Potato, and never let our relationship lose the silly, playful side that makes it uniquely ours.

I promise to keep making ordinary moments special with you. Whether we're exploring a new place, taking hundreds of photos, going on little adventures, or simply sitting together doing nothing, I'll cherish the time we share.
I promise to be faithful to you and honest with you. I want my actions, not just my words, to reassure you that you are the woman I love and the person I want to build my future with.
I promise to respect your individuality, your feelings, your boundaries, and your need for space when you need it. Loving you means supporting you as your own person, not expecting you to be perfect.

I promise to keep learning how to love you better. I know neither of us will always get everything right, but I'll keep reflecting, improving, apologising when I'm wrong, and doing my part to make our relationship stronger.

I promise to never take your efforts for granted. Every journey you make, every sacrifice you consider, every time you make space for me in your life, and every little thing you do for us will always mean something to me.

I promise to keep dreaming of our next chapter together. Hopefully, next year I'll get to call you my wife, and we'll begin building our life together—one filled with love, laughter, shared responsibilities, silly fights, endless memories, and a lifetime of being each other's strength. ❤️

futureCards.title: Our Registry Marriage (Next Year!)
futureCards.description: Our first big step towards forever! ❤️ Signing those papers, holding your hand, and officially becoming husband and wife. It might be a simple ceremony, but it will mean the world to me because I'll finally get to call you my wife and begin our life together.

futureCards.title: Our First Trip & Vietnam Dreams
futureCards.description: Our first trip as we begin this new chapter! Maybe we'll explore somewhere in India first, enjoy new places, try delicious food, and collect memories together. Once all your paperwork is successfully completed, Vietnam will be waiting for us—and after that, so many more places to explore. The destination matters, but travelling with you is what will make every trip special. ❤️

futureCards.title: One City, One Home, One Life
futureCards.description: Moving to a metro city where you and I can find better career opportunities and finally live together. No more counting the days until we meet or saying goodbye after every visit. Just us, sharing everyday moments, supporting each other's dreams, coming home to each other, and slowly building the life we've always imagined.

futureCards.title: Our Little World of Adventures
futureCards.description: Switching jobs when the right opportunities come along, growing in our careers, and celebrating every milestone together. ❤️ And who knows, maybe we'll even start a travel vlog or a little social media account to document our adventures! More trips, more silly videos, more pictures, more laughter, and countless stories that we'll look back on years from now.

futureCards.title: Our Big Fat Social Wedding!
futureCards.description: And then comes the celebration we've been dreaming about! A beautiful social wedding with our families, relatives, friends, and so many people who matter to us. Dressing up, exchanging vows, taking a million photographs, and celebrating our love with everyone. After all the planning and waiting, I can't wait to see you as my bride and celebrate our love in the biggest, happiest way we can. ❤️

futureCards.title: Our Family, Our Adventures, Forever Us
futureCards.description: More trips, more career milestones, more ordinary days together, and perhaps one day, a little baby who brings a whole new kind of happiness into our lives. ❤️ We'll learn to be parents, figure things out as a team, make beautiful family memories, and continue exploring the world whenever we can. And decades later, when our hair has turned grey and we're teasing each other just like we do today, I hope you'll still be my Potato Babu and I'll still be your Banana. Different chapters, countless memories, and one love that keeps growing older with us.
